ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In order to investigate the effect of auxin, corn coleoptile segments with the tips removed were randomly divided into two groups. In the experimental group, an agar block containing an appropriate concentration of IAA was placed on one side of the upper end of the coleoptile; in the control group, an agar block not containing IAA was placed on the same side of the upper end of the coleoptile. The two groups of coleoptiles were placed under the same conditions in the dark for a period of time. Afterward, the control group coleoptiles showed no bending growth, while the experimental group coleoptiles showed bending growth, as shown in the figure. According to the experimental results, what is the comparative relationship between the IAA content on side b of the coleoptile and side c of the coleoptile?
